No neuroevolution or FlyLoop module imports; orjson used only to parse large 470 MB raw JSON. All actual physical microintegrations tested; independent wall ray-casting every 16th microstep. Source script provided with original artifact.

interpretation: Slow-to-fast teaching is implemented and reduces collisions compared with naive imitation in one nearfield changed environment but fails the preregistered superiority over old-shuffled lessons, fixed fast output, repeated-contact reduction and salient-teaching sufficiency.
limitations: This is a numerical consistency audit in a researcher-designed synthetic world. Original 16-unit slow neuronal activations are logged and original coefficients held fixed but their full independent recurrent equation was not reconstructed in this standalone audit. Full 8-channel wall-ray states were independently recalculated once every 16 actual microsteps, not every single microstep. The old-shuffled control receives fewer updates due to its preregistered historical availability restriction, so it is not perfectly update-count matched. No empirical animal behavior evidence.
